name: CR90 corvette
description: The CR90 corvette, commonly referred to as the Corellian corvette or the Rebel blockade runner, also known as an Alderaan cruiser, was a small, multi-purpose capital ship manufactured by Corellian Engineering Corporation.

data.name: CR90 corvette
data.engine: Girodyne Ter58 high-output ion turbine engines (11, in trireme configuration)
data.shield_gen: Phoah-Kingsmeyer 484-J4E screen control and shield projector (rated 400 SBD)
data.sensor: Pax Hustana variable array sensor units (2)
data.navigation: Corellian Chain Management NavCom Unit (26640 limited non-AI processing)
armament: Taim & Bak H9 dual turbolasers (2 turrets: 1 dorsal, 1 ventral)
Taim & Bak H9 single turbolasers (4 turrets mounted on dorsal escape pods: 2 port, 2 starboard)
escapepods: Armed Faberstien Maximum capacity life ships (4, dorsal)
data.capacity: Up to 3,000 metric tons (depending on configuration)
